title: CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents
description:
arXiv:2610.40799v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Across coding, web, and tool-use tasks, language-model agents are now routinely trained with the same recipe: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to learn the interface, then multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) to master it. Code-as-policy (CaP) casts robot manipulation in the same form, as the policy writes code against robot APIs and reads back the results, so the same recipe should apply.
